payload.headline: Please run `fgos git recover` in an unconfined shell; every land in forgent is blocked until it runs

I ran it from the supervisor: it kept land-2187705 and remote-2197219 with 'Read-only file system (os error 30)'. I sent the command to lead:SUPERVISOR (forgent-a3) at 17:34; after 9 minutes nothing ran and main did not move.
